concept: Weighing short-term versus long-term outcomes before making a decision
source_inspiration: original content, informed by Sun Tzu's long-view strategic tradition — not sourced from any external text

exercise.scenario: Student faces a realistic choice with an appealing short-term payoff but a worse long-term outcome (or vice versa)
exercise.branching_choice: Student picks a path and sees the downstream effect play out
exercise.practice: Socratic follow-up on what made the short-term option tempting despite the tradeoff

assessment.success_marker: student can articulate the specific tradeoff they weighed, not just state their final choice
